_about: The Opening plan's one settings file (companion/opening_plan). Every list, time and number of the playbook is here, so a later playbook is a new file, not new code. Display only: nothing here places an order. See companion/opening_plan/__init__.py for where each number comes from.
name: OV OR1 shares

size._stage_about: Step 9 size stage (companion/plan_size.py, brief 19): what a plan entry sends. "1_share" (the default, the test stage) sends 1 share; 0.10, 0.25, 0.50 or 1.0 send floor(plan shares x stage), at least 1, inside the ticket's limits. Nothing else is allowed. Raising it is its own one-line PR that quotes Ash's go for that stage (who, when, where). A stage above 1 share needs EDGE_TRADER_PLAN_FLAT=1 (the cover watch) and the four points of README section "Before any stage above 1 share".

cover._about: Step 9 partial-fill cover watch (companion/plan_flat.py, brief 19 Part C), only with EDGE_TRADER_PLAN_FLAT=1. A plan row whose shares have no working stop for longer than this turns red with an Add stop button (the user's click). Display only: nothing is sent by the clock.

grace_seconds.note: start number, not approved by Ash

buttons._about: Step 4 row buttons (companion/plan_entries.py), only with EDGE_TRADER_PLAN_BUTTONS=1 and EDGE_TRADER_BREAK_ENTRY=1. Start value from the fast-open design (max 3 flips), not yet approved by Ash.

automatic._about: Step 5, shadow: what the automatic OR1 plan WOULD do (companion/opening_plan/engine.py). Nothing here sends, changes or cancels an order. Every number is a start number from the design (project memory ov-fast-open-design and ov-entries-failure-rules, 2026-11-13) that Ash has not approved; the tick study and shadow mornings are meant to set them.
